test_title: PYST 34: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 21 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

We have more then 6 years of experience in field hockey.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **part of the sentence that has an error** is *"then 6 years of".*
 
• The **correct word** to use here is *"than*", not *"then".*
 
• **"Than"** is a conjunction used in comparisons, while "then" is an adverb typically referring to time.

Therefore, the** correct sentence **would be: *"We have more than 6 years of experience in field hockey."*
